title: Text model choices changed
summary:
One text-and-image API PR added a small Llama option, fixed OpenRouter model selection, and made queue behavior less mysterious.

Added `llamalight` (Llama 3.2 3B Instruct) and an Azure-backed `gpt-4o-mini-roblox` generator with JSON-mode support. The listed Llama 3.3 70B chat and Llama 3.1 completion options were removed.

OpenRouter requests now use the specified model instead of always using DeepSeek Chat. Requests over the existing 300-item per-IP queue limit now receive a structured JSON 429 error.

The image queue wait changed from 500 ms per queued item to a fixed 500 ms. The same PR added text-request analytics, image-failure logging, and updated integration tests.

highlights.title: Llamalight joins text models
highlights.text: Try `llamalight`, based on Llama 3.2 3B Instruct, for text generation. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llamalight).
